title: ABLE And IBLE Words (15s micro-cut)
voice_notes: Remix variant - reuses lesson-08-able-ible audio via explicit segment keys. No new TTS.

segments.say: Some English words carry over into Spanish, but your mouth has to switch languages.
Today, use Spanish vowels and Spanish rhythm for words ending in ible and able.
Start with the English sentence: it is possible. Say it as English first, then switch into Spanish.
segments.show:
it is possible
switch to Spanish

segments.say: Build the whole sentence: it is possible.
Now do the same move with the English sentence: it is probable.
Build the whole sentence: it is probable.
Good. English gives you the word. Spanish gives you the sound.
segments.show:
English gives the word
Spanish gives the sound

caption: English gives you the word, Spanish gives you the sound: es posible, es probable.
